en: Sepia-toned panoramic view of a small European town with a railway junction and iron bridge in the foreground. Multiple train tracks curve under the bridge, flanked by fields and fences. Behind the railway lies a dense cluster of houses and industrial chimneys, rising up a hillside toward larger buildings and a prominent church or tower on the hilltop. The caption in the upper left reads "Nossen i. Sa.", printed in an old-style serif font.
